sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin, and I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店打碟时，你每晚也要带着你最珍视的300件物品

sentences.en: to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful
sentences.zh: 去工作，你会把DJ台变成一个鲜活的快闪博物馆，里面陈列着各种精美的

sentences.en: 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Janine Interlandi, and I'm a staff writer for The New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫珍妮·因特兰迪，是《纽约时报杂志》的一名专职撰稿人。

sentences.en: Imagine that you're born in a country, and you're a citizen of that country, and you've lived there your whole life.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，你出生在一个国家，你是那个国家的公民，并且你一生都生活在那里。

sentences.en: But you can't prove that you were born there.
sentences.zh: 但你却无法证明你出生在那里。

sentences.en: You can't prove how old you are or who your family is, because you don't have a record of your birth.
sentences.zh: 你无法证明自己的年龄或家庭背景，因为你没有任何出生记录。

sentences.en: You're essentially undocumented in your own country, which is another way of saying that you statistically and bureaucratically do not exiSt. So all the rights and protections
sentences.zh: 你实际上成了自己国家里的“无证者”，换句话说，从统计学和官僚机构的角度来看，你根本不存在。因此，公民身份所赋予的所有权利、保护

sentences.en: and liberties of citizenship, you have no guarantee that you're going to be able to access any of that.
sentences.zh: 和自由，你都无法保证自己能够享有。

sentences.en: It turns out, this describes a startlingly high proportion of the world's population.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这种情况描述了全球人口中惊人比例的一部分人。

sentences.en: There's an estimated 2 billion people on the planet right now that do not have birth certificates.
sentences.zh: 据估计，目前地球上有20亿人没有出生证明。

sentences.en: Not only that, roughly half of the 60 million deaths that occur each year are not actually recorded in any meaningful way, meaning the death is either not logged anywhere
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，每年发生的约6000万例死亡中，大约有一半实际上没有以任何有效的方式被记录下来，这意味着死亡要么根本没有被登记

sentences.en: at all, or if it is, the cause of death is not determined, which means we have no idea what killed the person.
sentences.zh: ，要么即使登记了，也无法确定死因，这意味着我们根本不知道是什么导致了这些人的死亡。

sentences.en: This kind of paperwork might seem like esoteric, bureaucratic stuff, but it lies at the root of all kinds of global health policies and human rights protections.
sentences.zh: 这类文书工作看起来可能有些深奥和官僚，但它却是各类全球卫生政策和人权保护的根基。

sentences.en: It's boring, it's wonky, but it can also be a matter of life and death.
sentences.zh: 它枯燥乏味，甚至有些繁琐，但它也可能关乎生死。

sentences.en: On a community level, it's difficult for officials to allocate resources if they don't know how big their population is,
sentences.zh: 在社区层面，如果官员们不知道人口规模，就很难分配资源，

sentences.en: because you don't know who's living, who's dying, what they're dying of, or in what proportion.
sentences.zh: 因为你不知道谁活着，谁死了，他们因何而死，或者死亡比例是多少。

sentences.en: And then, on a global scale, how can we conquer hunger, or malaria, or tuberculosis if we don't have baseline data on how prevalent these conditions are?
sentences.zh: 而在全球范围内，如果我们没有关于这些疾病流行程度的基础数据，我们又该如何战胜饥饿、疟疾或肺结核呢？

sentences.en: How can we possibly figure out whether any given initiative is working or not?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么可能判断某项倡议是否有效呢？

sentences.en: Without good birth and death counts, we're just flying blind.
sentences.zh: 如果没有准确的出生和死亡统计数据，我们就像是在盲目飞行。

sentences.en: When my editor and I first decided to pursue the story, there were several countries on the table.
sentences.zh: 当我和编辑最初决定跟进这个故事时，有几个国家在考虑范围内。

sentences.en: Bangladesh was one, Rwanda was another, but we settled on Colombia for a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 孟加拉国是一个，卢旺达是另一个，但我们最终选择了哥伦比亚，原因有几点。

sentences.en: The first reason is that Colombia is a country of dichotomies.
sentences.zh: 第一个原因是哥伦比亚是一个充满二元对立的国家。

sentences.en: In its two biggest cities,
sentences.zh: 在它的两大城市，

sentences.en: Bogota and Medellin, you have pretty good birth and death registration, actually about on par with what you would see in the United States or Europe.
sentences.zh: 波哥大和麦德林，出生和死亡登记做得相当不错，实际上与你在美国或欧洲看到的情况不相上下。

sentences.en: But in the rural parts of the country, which geographically speaking is actually the vast majority of the country, you have very poor registration.
sentences.zh: 但在该国的农村地区——从地理上讲，这实际上占了该国绝大部分地区——登记工作却非常糟糕。

sentences.en: The other reason we chose Colombia is that I was actually born there, in Medellin, and I myself do not have a birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 我们选择哥伦比亚的另一个原因是，我本人就出生在那里，在麦德林，而我本人也没有出生证明。

sentences.en: So I have some personal experience with the issue.
sentences.zh: 所以我对这个问题有一些亲身经历。

sentences.en: I was adopted.
sentences.zh: 我是被领养的。

sentences.en: My parents brought me, my twin brother, and my older sister here from
sentences.zh: 我的父母把我、我的双胞胎兄弟和我的姐姐从

sentences.en: Colombia as infants, and they did not get us naturalized, which is a whole other story.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚带到了这里，当时我们还是婴儿，他们没有给我们办理入籍手续，那是另一个故事了。

sentences.en: I only discovered this when I turned 16, and like any American kid, tried to get my learner's permit so I could get a driver's license.
sentences.zh: 我直到16岁才发现这一点，当时我像任何美国孩子一样，试图去考驾照的实习许可证。

sentences.en: And it turns out you need a birth certificate to do that.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，你需要出生证明才能办理。

sentences.en: And not having one created all sorts of problems that it took my siblings and I years to sort through.
sentences.zh: 没有出生证明引发了各种各样的问题，我和我的兄弟姐妹花了几年时间才解决。

sentences.en: So that was one of the very first things that actually sparked my interest in this story.
sentences.zh: 所以，这实际上是我对这个故事产生兴趣的最早原因之一。

sentences.en: This story is about the global quest to improve birth and death registrations.
sentences.zh: 这个故事是关于全球范围内改善出生和死亡登记的探索。

sentences.en: But it's also about this one family in particular, the Noskew family.
sentences.zh: 但它也特别讲述了一个家庭——诺斯克（Noskew）一家的故事。

sentences.en: They're pineapple farmers, they're part of the Nassau indigenous community, and they live in a very remote part of southern
sentences.zh: 他们是菠萝种植户，属于拿骚（Nassau）原住民社区，居住在南部一个非常偏远的地区

sentences.en: Colombia.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚。

sentences.en: Because they live in this rural place, their baby was born at home.
sentences.zh: 因为他们住在农村，所以他们的孩子是在家里出生的。

sentences.en: And because the baby was born at home, he didn't have a birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 由于孩子是在家里出生的，他没有出生证明。

sentences.en: Their story was really moving to me for reasons that I hope will be apparent.
sentences.zh: 他们的故事让我非常感动，原因我希望你们能明白。

sentences.en: So here's my article, The Life-Saving Power of Paperwork, read by Almarine Guerra de Wilson.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章《文书工作的救命力量》，由阿尔玛琳·格拉·德·威尔逊朗读。
zh_words: 阿尔玛琳·格拉·德·威尔逊朗读

sentences.en: The roads surrounding the Jerusalén-San Luis Alto Picurito indigenous reservation in Putomayo,
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚普图马约省的耶路撒冷-圣路易斯·阿尔托·皮库里托（Jerusalén-San Luis Alto Picurito）原住民保护区周围，
zh_words: 圣路易斯·阿尔托·皮库里托

sentences.en: Colombia, are treacherous on a good day.
sentences.zh: 道路即使在天气好的时候也险象环生。

sentences.en: Made mostly of gravel and mud, they narrow to barely the width of a small truck in some places.
sentences.zh: 路面大多由碎石和泥土铺成，有些地方窄到仅能容纳一辆小卡车通过。

sentences.en: And in others, especially after a storm, they yield almost completely to the many rivers with which they intersect.
sentences.zh: 而在其他地方，特别是在暴雨过后，道路几乎完全被与之交汇的众多河流所淹没。

sentences.en: They also twist and turn and bump without stop.
sentences.zh: 它们还不停地蜿蜒曲折、颠簸起伏。

sentences.en: So, in the most difficult months of her pregnancy, when everything tasted like cardboard and it hurt even to sit or stand, Marleni Mesa avoided traveling altogether.
sentences.zh: 因此，在怀孕最艰难的几个月里，当吃什么都像嚼纸板，甚至坐着或站着都感到疼痛时，马莱妮·梅萨（Marleni Mesa）完全避免了出行。

sentences.en: This meant skipping checkups at the clinic in Villa Garzón, which could take two hours or more to get to.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她错过了在比利亚加尔松（Villa Garzón）诊所的检查，去那里可能需要两个多小时甚至更久。

sentences.en: But Marleni wasn't overly worried.
sentences.zh: 但马莱妮并没有过度担心。

sentences.en: A nurse had assured her early in her pregnancy that her blood work was good and that everything looked fine.
sentences.zh: 一位护士在怀孕早期向她保证，她的血液检查结果很好，一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: As a midwife herself, Marleni knew that making the trip would be riskier than missing a few doctor's visits.
sentences.zh: 作为一名助产士，马莱妮知道长途跋涉的风险比错过几次产检要大得多。

sentences.en: But now, in the final days of her pregnancy, she could not shake the feeling that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但现在，在怀孕的最后几天，她无法摆脱一种不祥的预感。

sentences.en: She could barely breathe, for one thing.
sentences.zh: 首先，她几乎无法呼吸。

sentences.en: For another, her anxiety and physical discomfort were approaching what felt like an unbearable peak.
sentences.zh: 其次，她的焦虑和身体不适正接近一种难以忍受的顶峰。

sentences.en: Her husband, Andres Nosque, called for an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫安德烈斯·诺斯克（Andres Nosque）叫了救护车。

sentences.en: Hours passed, and none came.
sentences.zh: 几个小时过去了，救护车没来。

sentences.en: He'd tried to find a car to take her to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他试着找辆车带她去医院。

sentences.en: He'd also summoned Marleni's sister, Omaida, a prophet of their church, to come pray over her belly.
sentences.zh: 他还召集了马莱妮的姐姐奥迈达（Omaida），她是他们教会的先知，来为她的肚子祈祷。

sentences.en: That seemed to do the trick.
sentences.zh: 这似乎起了作用。

sentences.en: Marleni's breathing evened out, and a week or so later, she delivered a tiny, squirming boy with jet black hair and soft, curious eyes.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮的呼吸平稳了下来，大约一周后，她生下了一个瘦小、扭动着身体的男孩，他有着乌黑的头发和柔软、好奇的眼睛。

sentences.en: The couple named him Eliad.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇给他取名为埃利亚德（Eliad）。

sentences.en: Marleni thought he was perfect.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮觉得他很完美。

sentences.en: But her mother, a retired midwife, insisted that the placenta contained a hint of trouble.
sentences.zh: 但她的母亲，一位退休的助产士，坚持认为胎盘显示出了一丝隐患。

sentences.en: It was far too big, she said, and Eliad was too small, probably because he did not have enough room in her womb to grow.
sentences.zh: 她说，胎盘太大了，而埃利亚德太小了，可能是因为他在子宫里没有足够的生长空间。

sentences.en: His grandmother thought he might need an incubator.
sentences.zh: 他的祖母认为他可能需要保温箱。

sentences.en: Marleni thought he was fine.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮觉得他很好。

sentences.en: But when the baby was a few days old, she and Andres took him to Villegarzon for a checkup, just to be safe.
sentences.zh: 但当孩子出生几天后，她和安德烈斯还是带他去比利亚加尔松做了检查，以防万一。

sentences.en: This proved harder than they expected.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这比他们预想的要困难。

sentences.en: The baby could not be seen at the hospital there, until he had a civil identification or registration number, which he could not get without a birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 在孩子拥有公民身份证明或登记号码之前，医院无法为他看病，而没有出生证明他就无法获得这些。

sentences.en: Which the hospital could not provide, because the baby was born at home.
sentences.zh: 医院无法提供出生证明，因为孩子是在家里出生的。

sentences.en: Go to the registrar's office, the nurses told Marleni and Andres.
sentences.zh: 护士告诉马莱妮和安德烈斯去登记处。

sentences.en: But the registrar's office only sent Andres back to the hospital, where a different nurse told them to try the notary's office instead.
sentences.zh: 但登记处只是把安德烈斯又打发回了医院，而医院里另一位护士告诉他们去公证处试试。

sentences.en: By then, it was almost noon.
sentences.zh: 到那时，已经是中午了。

sentences.en: The only bus of the day would be heading back to San Luis soon.
sentences.zh: 当天唯一一班回圣路易斯的巴士很快就要开了。

sentences.en: If Andres and his family missed it, they would have to cough up more money for room and board in town than they normally spent in a week.
sentences.zh: 如果安德烈斯和他的家人错过了这班车，他们就得支付比平时一周生活费还多的钱在镇上食宿。

sentences.en: So they went home.
sentences.zh: 所以他们回家了。

sentences.en: The couple returned a few days later, but the registrar's instructions were different and more complicated this time.
sentences.zh: 几天后这对夫妇又回来了，但这次登记员的指示不同了，也更复杂了。

sentences.en: They would need two witnesses from their reservation, he said, and several documents, including one with the baby's blood type,
sentences.zh: 他说，他们需要来自保护区的两名证人，以及几份文件，包括一份带有孩子血型的文件，

sentences.en: and another showing the medical care Marleni received during her pregnancy, in order to prove that he was born inside the nation's borders, and that he was, in fact, their child.
sentences.zh: 以及另一份显示马莱妮在怀孕期间接受医疗护理的文件，以证明他出生在国境内，并且确实是他们的孩子。

sentences.en: The man seemed suspicious, Andres said, and asked many questions that he did not ask the first time.
sentences.zh: 安德烈斯说，那个人看起来很怀疑，问了许多第一次没问的问题。

sentences.en: There was nothing we could do,
sentences.zh: 我们无能为力，

sentences.en: Andres told me one sweltering July afternoon as we sat in the shade of his family's covered wooden porch.
sentences.zh: 安德烈斯在一个闷热的七月午后坐在他家带顶棚的木门廊下对我说道。

sentences.en: They didn't believe the child was ours, so we went home again.
sentences.zh: 他们不相信孩子是我们的，所以我们又回家了。

sentences.en: The couple planned to return to Villagarzon as soon as they were able to stay overnight, so they could sort everything out once and for all.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇计划一旦能留宿就尽快回到比利亚加尔松，这样他们就能一劳永逸地解决所有问题。

sentences.en: But before they got the chance,
sentences.zh: 但在他们有机会这样做之前，

sentences.en: Eliad developed a terrifying rash, with blisters on his head and face, and began gasping for breath.
sentences.zh: 埃利亚德长出了可怕的皮疹，头上和脸上起了水泡，并开始喘不过气来。

sentences.en: The family returned to Villagarzon for the third time.
sentences.zh: 一家人第三次回到比利亚加尔松。

sentences.en: Marleni waited at the hospital, while Andres went to the notary.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮在医院等候，而安德烈斯去了公证处。

sentences.en: This time, he was in luck.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他运气不错。

sentences.en: A clerk there put him in touch with Lady Rodriguez, a community health worker who works with a program known as
sentences.zh: 那里的办事员让他联系上了社区卫生工作者莱迪·罗德里格斯（Lady Rodriguez），她参与了一个名为

sentences.en: Colombia Rural Vital, one of several initiatives begun by the non-profits
sentences.zh: “哥伦比亚农村活力”（Colombia Rural Vital）的项目，这是非营利组织

sentences.en: Vital Strategies and Bloomberg Philanthropies as part of a broader effort to improve birth and death registries around the world.
sentences.zh: “活力策略”（Vital Strategies）和彭博慈善基金会（Bloomberg Philanthropies）发起的几项倡议之一，旨在改善全球出生和死亡登记工作。

sentences.en: By the organization's estimate, some 2 billion people do not have birth certificates, and only half of the 60 million or so deaths
sentences.zh: 据该组织估计，约有20亿人没有出生证明，而每年发生的约6000万例死亡中，只有一半

sentences.en: that occur each year are recorded in any meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 以任何有效的方式被记录下来。

sentences.en: The consequences of this failure are manifold and frequently dire.
sentences.zh: 这种失败的后果是多方面的，而且往往是可怕的。

sentences.en: Families like the Nosquist struggle to access the rights and benefits of citizenship.
sentences.zh: 像诺斯克这样的家庭难以获得公民权利和福利。

sentences.en: Government officials struggle to allocate resources and formulate evidence-based health policies.
sentences.zh: 政府官员难以分配资源和制定基于证据的卫生政策。

sentences.en: And a roster of identity-based crimes, from election chicanery to child trafficking, are allowed to proliferate.
sentences.zh: 一系列基于身份的犯罪，从选举舞弊到人口贩卖，也得以滋生。

sentences.en: The problem of inadequate registries is most pressing in the low-income nations of Africa and Southeast Asia, but it is not confined to those regions.
sentences.zh: 登记不足的问题在非洲和东南亚的低收入国家最为紧迫，但并不局限于这些地区。

sentences.en: In Colombia, birth and death registration is especially spotty in indigenous and Afro-descendant communities, where the national government tends to have little presence,
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚，出生和死亡登记在原住民和非裔社区尤其零散，因为国家政府在这些地方往往存在感很弱，

sentences.en: and registrars and notaries tend to apply the rules arbitrarily.
sentences.zh: 而且登记员和公证员往往随意执行规则。

sentences.en: Colombia Rural Vital was created to simplify and democratize this process.
sentences.zh: “哥伦比亚农村活力”项目的创建就是为了简化和普及这一流程。

sentences.en: Rodriguez, a petite woman in her mid-thirties who exudes an earnest pluck,
sentences.zh: 罗德里格斯是一位三十多岁、身材娇小、散发着真诚果敢气质的女性，

sentences.en: rushed to the notary's office soon after the clerk called her.
sentences.zh: 在办事员给她打电话后不久，她就赶到了公证处。

sentences.en: She asked Andres a series of questions about Eliad, entered his answers into an app on her tablet, and certified the baby's birth and parentage, all in less than an hour.
sentences.zh: 她向安德烈斯询问了一系列关于埃利亚德的问题，将他的回答输入到平板电脑的应用程序中，并在不到一小时的时间内证明了孩子的出生和亲子关系。

sentences.en: Andres would need to complete a few more forms, she explained, but Eliad had a birth certificate now and could see the doctor right away.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，安德烈斯还需要填写几份表格，但埃利亚德现在有了出生证明，可以立即去看医生了。

sentences.en: Andres took the certificate to the hospital.

sentences.en: Verbal autopsy initiatives are taking root.

sentences.en: And mobile technology is being employed in all those countries and elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 移动技术也正在所有这些国家及其他地区得到应用。

sentences.en: It's not a pipe dream anymore to say that we can count all births and deaths everywhere, says Settle, the vital strategies anthropologiSt.
sentences.zh: “说我们可以在世界各地统计所有出生和死亡人数，这不再是白日梦，”生命战略组织（Vital Strategies）的人类学家塞特尔（Settle）说。

sentences.en: We have the technology to do that.
sentences.zh: “我们有技术做到这一点。”

sentences.en: It doesn't even necessarily need to be super expensive.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不一定非要非常昂贵。

sentences.en: But for the scores of individual pilot programs that are emerging now to morph into strong national institutions, leaders in every sphere of government will have to step up.
sentences.zh: 但要让现在涌现的众多试点项目转变为强大的国家机构，政府各个领域的领导人都必须挺身而出。

sentences.en: We have to stop thinking of this as a health problem and start looking at it as a whole-of-government issue, health ministries will not be enough.
sentences.zh: 我们必须停止将其视为一个健康问题，而应开始将其视为一个全政府层面的问题，仅靠卫生部门是不够的。

sentences.en: Heads of state will have to get involved.
sentences.zh: 国家元首必须参与进来。

sentences.en: And they will have to do more than just establish or strengthen registries.
sentences.zh: 而且他们必须做的不仅仅是建立或加强登记系统。

sentences.en: They will have to scale up social services in ways that pay more than lip service to the marginalized.
sentences.zh: 他们必须扩大社会服务规模，以切实而非口头地支持边缘化群体。

sentences.en: Citizenship is only as valuable as the rights and protections it provides.
sentences.zh: 公民身份的价值取决于它所提供的权利和保护。

sentences.en: And the problem of birth and death registration is inextricably bound to the problem of social safety nets.
sentences.zh: 出生和死亡登记问题与社会安全网问题有着千丝万缕的联系。

sentences.en: In this regard, the Nosque story offers a parable of sorts.
sentences.zh: 在这方面，诺斯克（Nosque）一家的故事提供了一个寓言。

sentences.en: In principle, at least, every Colombian citizen has access to the nation's health care system.
sentences.zh: 原则上，至少每一位哥伦比亚公民都有权享受国家的医疗保健系统。

sentences.en: But without reliable roads or accessible clinics,
sentences.zh: 但由于缺乏可靠的道路或可及的诊所，

sentences.en: Madalene was forced to carry and deliver her baby without the benefits of that resource.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮被迫在没有这些资源支持的情况下怀孕并分娩。

sentences.en: As a result, her enlarged placenta went undiagnosed, and her baby was caught in a vicious cycle.
sentences.zh: 结果，她增大的胎盘未被诊断出来，她的孩子陷入了一个恶性循环。

sentences.en: Born at home because his parents could not access the health care system, and then unable to access the health care system because he was born at home.
sentences.zh: 因为父母无法获得医疗服务而在家中出生，又因为在家中出生而无法获得医疗服务。

sentences.en: As they waited to see how he would fare,
sentences.zh: 当他们等待看他情况如何时，

sentences.en: Eliad's family did all they could to spoil him.
sentences.zh: 埃利亚德的家人竭尽所能地宠爱他。

sentences.en: Whenever he woke from a nap or began cooing, they would stop what they were doing and flock to him.
sentences.zh: 每当他从午睡中醒来或开始咿呀学语，他们就会放下手中的活，围到他身边。

sentences.en: Andres encouraged Madalene to set aside her other responsibilities and spend every moment she could with the baby,
sentences.zh: 安德烈斯鼓励马莱妮放下其他责任，尽可能多地陪伴孩子，

sentences.en: partly to make sure he was okay, but also to savor him as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 一方面是为了确保他平安，另一方面也是为了尽可能多地享受与他在一起的时光。

sentences.en: So when he began spitting up excessively one Friday, nearly two weeks after their visit to Pasto, his parents noticed immediately.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他在一个周五，也就是他们去过帕斯托近两周后，开始频繁呕吐时，他的父母立刻注意到了。

sentences.en: He didn't have a fever or other symptoms, but he could not seem to keep anything down.
sentences.zh: 他没有发烧或其他症状，但他似乎什么都吃不下。

sentences.en: Madalene gathered plants and prepared an anti-nausea brew, which appeared to settle his stomach.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮采集了一些植物，熬制了一种止吐药，似乎缓解了他的胃部不适。

sentences.en: But the couple agreed that if the sickness returned, they would take him to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 但夫妻俩商定，如果病情复发，他们就带他去医院。

sentences.en: The weekend passed, and Eliad once again seemed to push through his difficulties.
sentences.zh: 周末过去了，埃利亚德似乎再次挺过了难关。

sentences.en: By Saturday, he was cooing and smiling again, well enough to join the family at church that evening.
sentences.zh: 到了周六，他又开始咿呀学语和微笑，身体状况足以让他当晚随家人去教堂。

sentences.en: But on Sunday, when Madalene woke, he was short of breath.
sentences.zh: 但在周日，当马莱妮醒来时，他呼吸急促。

sentences.en: We should leave, she said, waking Andres.
sentences.zh: “我们得走了，”她说，叫醒了安德烈斯。

sentences.en: It was still dark out.
sentences.zh: 外面天还没亮。

sentences.en: The bus would not come for hours.
sentences.zh: 巴士还要几个小时才会来。

sentences.en: Andres called for an ambulance without much hope, and then went out to look for transportation, while Madalene alternated between readying Eliad for the hospital
sentences.zh: 安德烈斯在没抱太大希望的情况下叫了救护车，然后出去寻找交通工具，而马莱妮则在为埃利亚德去医院做准备，

sentences.en: and trying to soothe him as best she could.
sentences.zh: 并尽她所能安抚他。

sentences.en: She yelled for her father to bring a blanket.
sentences.zh: 她大声叫她父亲拿条毯子来。

sentences.en: One does not know what to do in that desperation, she told me later.
sentences.zh: “人在那种绝望中不知道该怎么办，”她后来告诉我。

sentences.en: But before she could wrap him up, the baby fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 但在她还没来得及把他裹起来之前，孩子就睡着了。

sentences.en: And then, after a few short breaths, his heart stopped beating.
sentences.zh: 然后，在几次短促的呼吸后，他的心脏停止了跳动。

sentences.en: His funeral was a blur.
sentences.zh: 他的葬礼是一片模糊。

sentences.en: Madalene remembers only that the viewing and mass took a full day, and that their church honored him with a formal street procession en route to the graveyard.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮只记得瞻仰遗容和弥撒花了一整天，教堂在前往墓地的途中为他举行了正式的街头游行。

sentences.en: She remembers leaving home with the baby in her arms and returning several hours later, completely empty.
sentences.zh: 她记得抱着孩子离开家，几个小时后回来时，怀里空空如也。

sentences.en: Weeks later, when spring had yielded to summer and she and Andres were settled deep into their grief,
sentences.zh: 几周后，当春天让位于夏天，她和安德烈斯沉浸在深深的悲痛中时，

sentences.en: Rodriguez, the health worker, and several nurses visited the family to perform a verbal autopsy and provide a death certificate.
sentences.zh: 卫生工作者罗德里格斯（Rodriguez）和几名护士拜访了这家人，进行了口头尸检并提供了死亡证明。

sentences.en: They spent a full hour questioning Madalene and Andres about Eliad's illness and the circumstances of his death.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一整小时询问马莱妮和安德烈斯关于埃利亚德的病情和死亡情况。

sentences.en: The information they collected would be fed into a computer and sent to a national repository, where it would join a mountain of similar data.
sentences.zh: 他们收集的信息将被输入电脑并发送到国家数据库，在那里它将汇入堆积如山的类似数据中。

sentences.en: That data would be churned into statistics on who was dying in Colombia and how.
sentences.zh: 这些数据将被处理成关于哥伦比亚谁在死亡以及如何死亡的统计数据。

sentences.en: And eventually, those statistics would be used to shape policies and guide resources.
sentences.zh: 最终，这些统计数据将被用于制定政策和引导资源。

sentences.en: But nothing in that long process would alter the basic facts.
sentences.zh: 但在那个漫长的过程中，没有任何东西能改变基本事实。

sentences.en: Eliad Nosque Mesa lived for 87 days and died in the same house where he was born.
sentences.zh: 埃利亚德·诺斯克·梅萨（Eliad Nosque Mesa）活了87天，死在他出生的那所房子里。

sentences.en: His life was infinitesimally short and packed with far more than its share of suffering.
sentences.zh: 他的一生极其短暂，却承受了远超其应有的痛苦。

sentences.en: But he had still known joy.
sentences.zh: 但他依然感受过快乐。

sentences.en: He had known his family's love and his time here had mattered to them.
sentences.zh: 他感受过家人的爱，他在世的时间对他们来说意义重大。

sentences.en: Madalene and Andres took some comfort in knowing that, at the very least, his life had now been counted.
sentences.zh: 马莱妮和安德烈斯感到一丝慰藉，因为至少，他的一生现在被统计在册了。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
